summary: Full audit of Guides.jsx, GuideDetail.jsx, HeroSection.jsx, and backend /api/guides. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend: /guides renders 3 cards with 4 category chips (All+3), Freelancing filter narrows to 1 card, first card image loads (naturalWidth=1200). Clicking a card navigates to detail; guide-detail-page, guide-title, guide-content all render; markdown body length 2714 chars (not stuck on spinner); hero image loads (naturalWidth=1200); guide-cta shows for logged-out; back link present. Invalid slug shows guide-not-found. Home hero renders hero-badge, hero-heading, hero-subtitle, hero-free-guides-cta pill; no page JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroSection.jsx line 133: stat.value.replace() will crash if a CMS admin publishes a numeric stat value. Consider String(stat.value).replace(...). Not triggered for logged-out users (which is what was tested).
Guides.jsx catches axios errors silently (line 35 empty .catch). Consider surfacing a user-visible error state instead of showing the empty-state message on network failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 published guides exist. Backend list+detail+404+category filter+admin protection all verified. Home hero, guides list, guide detail, and not-found flows verified in Playwright. Only two minor code review nits, no bugs.
